title: TrustRoot
description: The authoriser set + threshold a deployment trusts (m-of-n; 1 covers a solo owner). Only PUBLIC key material appears here. The trust root's authenticity is anchored NOT by the copy shipped in a bundle but by its fingerprint, which the operator publishes OUT-OF-BAND: fingerprint = "sha256:" + digest_payload(this object). Reflects vigil_core.models.TrustRoot / AuthorizerKey.

threshold.description: m in m-of-n. MUST be <= number of authorizers.

authorizers.description: The governance authorisers. key_ids MUST be distinct.

public_key_b64.description: base64 of the 32-byte raw Ed25519 public key. A conforming verifier rejects a non-canonical (y >= 2^255-19) or small-order (low-subgroup) point before using it.
